note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Algeria has roughly 1,500 communes and this file ships without them rather than with invented ones: a wrong commune name is a rejected valid address and a failed delivery. Drop a real dataset in here and run `wp algerian-commerce import-algeria`. See the plugin README, section Algerian geography, for where to source one.

fields.wilaya_code: required — 1 to 58, as a number or a zero-padded string ("16", "06")
fields.name: required — the Latin name; it is the natural key, accent-folded
fields.name_ar: optional — Arabic label, never used as a key
fields.postal_code: optional — digits only, kept as a string so leading zeros survive
fields.is_active: optional — false hides the commune from delivery without deleting it
